title: Let's: suggestions and wishes
summary: Suggest and offer with the optative (*Gidelim mi?*, *Kapıyı açayım mı?*), say what someone else should do with the third-person imperative (*Ali gelsin*), use the set wishes of everyday life (*Kolay gelsin*, *Geçmiş olsun*, *Elinize sağlık*), and urge your friends on with *hadi*.
canDo: Suggest plans and offer to do things: Gidelim mi? Size yardım edeyim.
Say what someone else should do, and share out the jobs at home
Say the right wish at work, after an illness, after a meal or for something new
Make plans with friends and agree on a time and a place
